window.primary_date_basis: date submitted to a federal recipient; retain document signature date and upload date separately
window.retrieval_snapshot: 2026-10-25; not automatically a historical snapshot at the window end

target: All publicly available external written submissions to German federal legislative processes in the window, across ministry consultation pages, Bundestag hearing records and Lobbyregister disclosures.
process_scope: German federal statutes and ordinances; retain other parliamentary motions and non-legislative general hearings separately rather than silently treating them as legislation. Pure EU lobbying without an identified German federal legislative process is excluded.

unit.joint_authorship: one response, not one per signatory
unit.copies: merge ministry/register/hearing mirrors and repeat disclosures of the same authored response
unit.versions: retain substantively different versions and label them
unit.events: retain each delivery/recipient/process event separately without automatically counting it as a new document
unit.bundles: enumerate authored responses within hearing compilations, not one whole bundle or one repeated copy per author

discovery: Record authoritative ministry and committee master indexes, pagination, snapshot and process-page links.
Inspect forthcoming hearings with already-published in-window statements and older process pages with later submissions.
Enumerate the register by its recipient-date filter, traverse every result page and reconcile unique SG IDs against reported result counts.
Cross-reference the three channels. Search-engine results may discover omissions but cannot prove completeness.
Keep absent, blocked, undated, scope-uncertain and inaccessible material in a gap ledger.
meaning_of_checked: For any future complete-coverage statement, every eligible document must be read in full and its potentially material, checkable factual/numerical/source-description assertions assessed under the common protocol. Keyword triage or collection alone is not checked. A negative screen does not certify every assertion as true.
finding_rules: Preserve original ai_screened schema. Distinguish provisional findings, unresolved leads and rejected candidates; classify materiality independently of direction. Check context, qualifications, primary-source methods and exact addressed draft. No inference of intent, no invented author responses, no policy disagreement/forecast/absence of evidence treated as proven error.
completion_gate: Do not claim full three-channel coverage until authoritative enumeration, date/scope adjudication, document-version deduplication, access/reading gaps and the common substantive screening stage are complete. If any are incomplete, report exact achieved coverage by stage and remaining gaps; a completed register listing is only collection coverage for that source frame.
research_round: Additional2.5h started2026-10-25T02:41:17Z; earliest time-gate2026-10-25T05:11:17Z. User steering prioritises systematic coverage over opportunistic case discovery.
author_scope: All external written submissions, including companies, associations, NGOs, academics and experts; user expressly confirmed. Registered-interest status is a separate attribute, not an inclusion requirement.
government_response_handling: Government bodies and Länder are separately labelled and excluded from the external-stakeholder denominator unless an independently authored external contribution qualifies. Published reply totals may include them, but cannot be reported as the external-submission denominator.
